title: Corn, the day after
logline: Gully's counter the morning after the corn: the tray in the bin, the end stool pushed in, the bird gone from the rim, one kernel on the counter. Twenty-eight and a day.

panels.composition: A shop counter in morning light: an empty paper tray in a bin, the end stool pushed in, a single corn kernel on the wood, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shop counter in morning light with an empty paper tray in a bin, the end stool pushed in and a single corn kernel on the wood, a crowded corkboard above, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
